verdict.rationale: Riveter offers event-driven pieces but no rules engine. Webhooks fire a POST with full results on run.completed, run.stopped and run.finished events, and projects can be scheduled to monitor for changes, refreshing as often as every minute. There is no evidence that users can define conditional rules (if event X, then action Y) or chain arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: a user-defined rule/trigger builder, conditional actions on data-change events, support for action types beyond a single completion webhook, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
